description: Body mass index with the WHO adult category, the healthy weight range for your height (BMI 18.5–24.9), BMI Prime, optional waist-to-height ratio, and for adults (18–120, with age) BMR by Mifflin-St Jeor plus daily calories to maintain or lose ~0.5 kg (1 lb) a week at five activity levels. Metric (cm, kg) or imperial (ft + in, lb). Height 50–272 cm, weight 10–650 kg. Not medical advice; children need percentile charts. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/bmi-calc/

age.description: Age in years (adults 18+ get BMR and calories).

units.description: metric: cm and kg; imperial: ft + in and lb.

waist.description: Optional waist size in cm (metric) or inches (imperial).

name: calc_bmi
title: BMI calculator
